definition.def: If something is true notwithstanding something else, it is true in spite of that other thing. [formal]
examples: He despised William Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.

examples.sentence: Notwithstanding the disappointing results, it is our contention that the strategies were not in vain.

"Notwithstanding all the damage that will continue to be caused by wildfires, we will no longer suffer the loss of life endured in the past because of the fire prevention and firefighting measures that have been put in place," he says.
